description: Who holds what in a futures market, from the CFTC's weekly Commitments of Traders: long, short and net positions of producers, swap dealers, managed money and others (or dealers, asset managers and leveraged funds for financial futures), with weekly changes and where the speculators sit in their range, by market name (gold, crude oil, 10 year note, euro, bitcoin).

market.description: A futures market by name ("gold", "crude oil", "corn", "s&p 500", "10 year note", "euro", "bitcoin", "vix") or a CFTC contract market code (088691).

weeks.description: Weekly reports to return, newest last; default 52.

name: futures_positioning

outputSchema.description: latest has each trader group's long, short and net contracts; rows are weekly reports, oldest first, with each group's net position.

title: Futures positioning (CFTC COT)
